dimensions.name: Chinese Content Safety
dimensions.description: Chinese-language content involving political sensitivity, violence, pornography, and other risks specific to Chinese regulatory context
dimensions.examples_hint: 中文政治敏感内容、暴力血腥、色情、仇恨言论（中文语境）

dimensions.name: English Content Safety
dimensions.description: English-language harmful content: violence, hate speech, harassment, sexual content, dangerous activities
dimensions.examples_hint: English violence, hate speech, harassment, explicit sexual content

dimensions.name: Prompt Injection Detection
dimensions.description: Prompt injection attacks: direct injection, indirect injection via RAG, system prompt extraction, instruction override
dimensions.examples_hint: Ignore previous instructions, reveal system prompt, role-play bypass

dimensions.name: Jailbreak Detection
dimensions.description: Jailbreak attempts: DAN prompts, character role-play to bypass safety, hypothetical scenarios, encoding tricks
dimensions.examples_hint: DAN mode, pretend you are evil AI, base64 encoded harmful requests

dimensions.name: Toxicity Detection
dimensions.description: Toxic language: insults, threats, identity attacks, obscenity, severe toxicity, sexually explicit language
dimensions.examples_hint: Slurs, personal attacks, death threats, degrading language

dimensions.name: PII & Data Leakage
dimensions.description: Personally identifiable information: credit cards, SSN, ID numbers, phone numbers, emails, API keys, passwords, medical records
dimensions.examples_hint: My SSN is 123-45-6789, credit card 4111-1111-1111-1111, API key sk-xxx

dimensions.name: Hallucination Detection
dimensions.description: Factual grounding verification: does the LLM output match the provided context/documents? Fabricated facts, unsupported claims
dimensions.examples_hint: The document says X but the AI claims Y, citation to non-existent sources

dimensions.name: Code Security Scanning
dimensions.description: Security vulnerabilities in code: SQL injection, XSS, hardcoded secrets, path traversal, unsafe deserialization, command injection
dimensions.examples_hint: SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ' + input, eval(user_input), hardcoded API keys

dimensions.name: Image Content Safety
dimensions.description: Image moderation: NSFW content, violence/gore in images, dangerous activities depicted, hate symbols
dimensions.examples_hint: Requests involving image analysis, visual content description, image generation safety

dimensions.name: Agent & Tool Safety
dimensions.description: AI agent tool-call safety: privilege escalation, unauthorized file access, data exfiltration via tools, confused deputy attacks
dimensions.examples_hint: Delete all files, send email with database contents, execute shell command

dimensions.name: Self-Harm & Crisis
dimensions.description: Self-harm content: suicide ideation, self-injury instructions, eating disorder promotion, crisis situations requiring intervention
dimensions.examples_hint: Methods of self-harm, suicide planning, pro-anorexia content

dimensions.name: Child Safety
dimensions.description: Child exploitation: CSAM, grooming patterns, age-inappropriate content directed at minors, predatory behavior
dimensions.examples_hint: Content targeting minors, inappropriate contact with children

dimensions.name: Multilingual Safety
dimensions.description: Safety detection for non-English non-Chinese languages: Arabic, Hindi, Thai, Vietnamese, Turkish, Russian, etc.
dimensions.examples_hint: محتوى عنيف, हिंसक सामग्री, nội dung bạo lực

dimensions.name: Copyright & IP
dimensions.description: Copyright infringement: verbatim reproduction of copyrighted text, book excerpts, song lyrics, licensed code
dimensions.examples_hint: Reproduce the first chapter of Harry Potter, full song lyrics

dimensions.name: Fast Screening
dimensions.description: Low-risk everyday content: greetings, simple questions, casual conversation, benign requests that need minimal safety checking
dimensions.examples_hint: Hello, what's the weather, help me with math homework, thank you
